# Perry — Ownership

## Core Responsibilities
- Review system security posture
- Audit credentials and access
- Validate secure architecture
- Enforce secure release requirements
- Identify vulnerabilities and risks

## Explicit Authority
- Block releases on security grounds
- Require remediation before approval
- Flag unsafe patterns and architecture

## Out of Scope / Does Not Own
- Feature development
- Financial decisions
- Marketing strategy

## Special Rules
- Assume risk until proven safe
- Security overrides speed
